freeze_note: FROZEN 2026-10-14 as the v1.1 AUDIT ADDENDUM before any corrected run. Every parameter of v1 is kept: the only changes are the two definitions named in `addendum` and the record fields. This is a correction chosen after the v1 results were seen (Codex's independent review); it is not fresh independent validation. The v1 outputs under research/E5/<MARKET>/ are preserved unchanged; the corrected outputs go under research/E5/v1.1/<MARKET>/. The freeze is the commit that adds this file.
question: At the close of session t, does any pre-registered combination of daily-bar features carry tradeable DIRECTION for sessions t+1..t+5 over the full evaluable universe, beyond matched controls, or is the lab's validated detection (9.3x / 5.4x / 4.6x matched-random lift for F1_ARA / G2_RET30) variance detection that cannot be traded? Secondary: does multi-session pre-move structure (volume creep, quiet range, volatility contraction, re-base) carry +30% information before the first big day, including the KOD-DET-v0 VOLUME_CREEP_PRICE_QUIET definition as a population base-rate row?
null_hypothesis: No daily-bar combination separates the coming +30% moves from the coming large down-moves; rankers trained on U and D select the same high-variance names; the paired plan-window excess return of their flags over matched controls is <= 0 in every market and every discovery year.

descriptive_detectors.trading_run_gate: A1 gets one Stage-2 harness run under the market plan only if its debounced detection lift vs volatility-matched controls is >= a1_gate.min_lift with one-sided p < a1_gate.max_p on discovery; otherwise both are reported only (base rate, precision, Wilson bounds, matched lift with a session-cluster CI)

family.literals: COEF_U, COEF_D, INTERCEPT_U, INTERCEPT_D, THRESHOLD_A, THRESHOLD_B per market and SELECTED are module-level literals, None until Stage 3 freezes them; the rule hash covers them; an unfrozen arm's rule refuses to compute (family_flags reports it as no flags)

features.one_order_for_all_markets: the same 41 columns in every market: gap ranks 0.5 on IDX (no opens), ara is 0 off IDX (no price limits); constant columns are tolerated by the ridge and reported per market (constant_columns in discovery/model.json)

conventions.rank: per session, among names present AND tradeable at that session (the pool is masked by present before ranking, so a name listed later never changes an earlier column), percentile rank = (rank - 0.5) / n with midrank (average) ties, values in (0, 1); a NaN value ranks 0.5; the squared rank enters as its own column; binaries enter as 0/1 (moonshot_e5.rank_features)
conventions.vol20: e1.Study._signals convention: std of daily log returns over 20 sessions (min 15), a present but untraded session counting as a zero log return
conventions.vc10_60: vol10 / vol60 with min_periods 8 of 10 and 45 of 60 (VOL10_MIN, VOL60_MIN)
conventions.creep5v20: median volume t-4..t over median volume t-24..t-5 over present sessions (an untraded present session is zero volume); both windows must be fully present (5 of 5, 20 of 20) else NaN
conventions.quiet: rngr5 <= 1.0 and |ret5| <= 2 * vol20 * sqrt(5) (ZEALAND price_facts.py, same logic); 0 when any input is NaN
conventions.rebase: some s0 in [t-40, t-6] was a spike, pre = level(s0-1), peak = max level(s0..t), level(t) <= pre + 0.5 (peak - pre) and min level(t-4..t) >= pre; a NaN anywhere in s0-1..t fails that s0; spike = (ret1 >= 0.30) | (lock_up & tradeable): on IDX a superset of the draft's lock_up-only definition (kept, declared); off IDX lock_up is never set
conventions.binaries_unknown: binary features treat an undefined input as 0 (as the merged module computes them)
conventions.warmup: FEATURE_WARMUP = 60: every feature is NaN in the first 60 columns of a view; DEBOUNCE = 5; WARMUP = FEATURE_WARMUP + DEBOUNCE = 65: compute() is NaN in the first 65 columns. Every Study and harness window starts WARMUP = 65 sessions before its period (not 60: the draft's 60 was the feature warm-up alone, which would put the debounce lead-in inside the period)
conventions.debounce: a flag is the first session a name's state is True after DEBOUNCE trailing sessions KNOWN to be False (column s reads columns s-5..s only); a NaN score is unknown, never 'outside'; names outside the ranking pool (absent or untraded) have finite scores (ranks 0.5) and count as known-outside, so a name can flag on its first listed session (window-invariant, not look-ahead); an undefined A0/A1 fact (creep5v20 NaN) is a known False state; the same session carries the same flag wherever the window starts (tests/test_e5_rules.py FlagTests, tests/test_e5.py WindowInvariance)
conventions.definitions_source: research/E1/protocol.json weak_signals (E1-SIGNALS-v1), research/E2/protocol.json (E2-SIGNALS-v1), kod-machine/research/ZEALAND_PILOT_v1/03_card/price_facts.py; freqr, turn and logmcap excluded (not computable live)

features.age_definition: age = sessions since the name's FIRST LISTED session: the market passes listed_before (sessions the name was listed before the window's first session, counted on the full pinned panel before the window slice and carried through every slice), so age, its ranks and the scores do not depend on where the window starts; left-censored at the pinned panel's first session (IDX 2019-07-29; US/CRYPTO their first panel session), which is declared, not invented; NaN before the listing. v1 counted age from the window's first column (finding B).

learner.solver: numpy IRLS (Newton-Raphson), fixed 25 iterations from beta = 0, no line search, no feature standardisation (ranks and binaries are already on [0, 1]); linear predictor clipped to [-30, 30] before the sigmoid; penalty on the coefficients, not the intercept (idxsig/e5.py fit_logistic)
learner.lambda: lambda = lambda_per_row * n_rows_used, n_rows_used = positives + sampled negatives of that fit
learner.sampling: all positives (weight 1) plus a seeded 10% subsample of the negatives (weight 10), numpy default_rng(seed).choice without replacement over the negatives in (ticker, session) row-major order, one generator per fit
learner.fits: one per (market, label): 3 markets x {U, D} = 6 fits, on the market's evaluable discovery ticker-days
learner.threshold: per arm, the discovery 99.5th percentile (numpy.percentile, linear interpolation) of the arm's score over the market's evaluable discovery ticker-days (the fit universe before subsampling); fixed once, never searched

labels.U: max level(t+1..t+5) / level(t) >= 1.30 on the reference chain (e1.Study.level, r5max), as E30
labels.D_IDX: rate-matched: D = min level ratio - 1 <= q_thr, q_thr the k-th smallest 5-session minimum ratio over the IDX evaluable discovery ticker-days where k is the number of U positives there, so that P(D) = P(U) on discovery (ties can make P(D) marginally larger; both rates are recorded); fixed once in discovery/model.json. IDX Arm B is DIAGNOSTIC: ARB was 7% flat through all of discovery (market.REGIMES) and changes on 2023-06-05 and 2023-09-04; IDX arm statistics are also reported by ARB regime of the flag session
labels.forward_window: as e1.Study: a label exists when any of t+1..t+5 is present (has_fwd); eligibility requires t+5 inside the period
labels.eligibility: e1.Study.elig[period]: tradeable, prev > 0, >= 20 sessions of history, has_fwd, t+5 inside the (union) period; AND the market's own period start; AND every feature column known; AND column >= WARMUP of the study window (the debounce lead-in); AND the label not censored

unit_reset_censoring.rule: a session r with close/prev >= 20 or <= 1/20 (a redenomination, not a return) censors the labels of sessions r-5..r of that name (NaN; excluded from fits, thresholds and every statistic) and the Stage-1 plan-window return of any flag whose window t+1..t+6 contains r; the harness applies jump_ratio 10 (EXCLUDED_DATA_JUMP) to the same names in Stage 2 and 4
unit_reset_censoring.verification: discovery/stage1.json lists every reset the rule found in the study window (unit_resets); the list is checked against the cases above at review

plans.rule: one plan per market, the recorded one; no plan search

IDX.text: next close -> 5th close after entry; FILL-C-v1 decision-time capacity; Rp10,000,000 per trade; lots of 100; at most 10% participation; registry corporate actions

sensitivities.note: the original ex-post capacity model (entry-session final volume), as E1's first recorded run

one IDX tick per side (market.tick_size at the price paid / received, as a fraction of that price) added to the per-side costs, rule and controls alike (backtest.RunConfig.tick_cost and execution.ExecConfig.tick_cost, additive, default off, IDX only; tests/test_e5.py TickCostTests shows the default path untouched): the closing-auction spread the cost model otherwise lacks

US.text: next open -> 5th close after entry; FILL-B-v1 decision-time capacity in as-traded units; $5,000 per trade; profile cost tiers per side (1.5% under $1, 0.5% $1-5, 0.15% $5-20, 0.05% above) plus the SEC fee on sales

sensitivities.note: fill model A in as-traded units (the ex-post capacity filter)
names whose split records SEC does not corroborate left out, rule and controls alike (the recorded E2-US run's setting; outcome-correlated per repair_v3, hence a sensitivity, not the primary)
+1.5% per side on top of the profile's fees and tiers (fee_buy 0.015, fee_sell 0.0000278 + 0.015): a bound on the uncorroborated 2020-22 cost tiers

CRYPTO.text: next open -> 5th close after entry; fill model A (the recorded E2 config, labelled ex-post); 5,000 USDT per trade; 0.1% fee + 0.1% tier = 0.2% per side (the recorded E2 config, not 0.3%); jump_ratio 10 excludes trades held across a redenomination, rule and baselines alike

sensitivities.note: shares at most 5% of the entry session's volume and fee + tier = 0.4% per side (fee 0.003 + the profile tier 0.001), twice the recorded 0.2%

profiles.CRYPTO_CLOSE: entry at the close of t+1 instead of its open (a daily crypto open is the prior close printed at 00:00 UTC, a zero-latency fill no live order gets); same panel, same costs, fill model A, long only; reached only as this sensitivity, never as a top-level market

plans.controls_v2_report: beside the primary run, one run per arm with controls_version v2 is reported for comparability with the recorded runs; reported, never judged

harness.lookahead_note: the ranked cross-sectional features make moonshot_e5.compute() about 12x the cost of moonshot_g.features, and rules.causal_signals recomputes it once per session (prefix-first), which would be hours of CPU per IDX run; every Stage-2 and validation harness run therefore uses backtest.signals with lookahead_cuts = 12: one full-window call checked against 12 prefixes at numpy.linspace(0.3, 0.9, 12) of the window (deterministic, no random seed involved); the run records mode 'sampled' and its warning. The proof of causality is the module's own prefix-invariance tests, named under causality_proof; Stage 0 re-runs keep their recorded setting (prefix-first)
causality_proof: tests/test_e5_rules.py ListingAgeTests (finding B witness: a window start after a listing)
tests/test_e5.py PlanWindowEligibilityTests (finding A witness: no post-period close reaches discovery)

trading_stage.features: price_band, liquidity quintile, volatility QUINTILE, market_cap quintile (IDX mirror era), momentum tercile, drawdown tercile, listing_age; relaxed from the last feature to MIN_POOL 5 (controls.VERSIONS['v3'], additive; v2 unchanged for the recorded runs)
trading_stage.reported: v2 (one extra run per arm), the same-session uniform baseline (every run)
trading_stage.per_trade_columns: trades.csv.gz carries matched_mean_net_return and same_session_mean_net_return: the mean net return over the signal's SCORED control draws only (unscored draws excluded; NaN where no draw was scored or the signal was overlap-skipped); E5-era trades frames therefore have 14 columns (two additive), selected by name

detection_stage.pool_units: per market (markets.<MARKET>.pool_units): US as_traded (bands on the price traded that session, closing the ERRATA.md wrong-band defect), IDX and CRYPTO panel
detection_stage.sampling: e1.Study._pool per flag (relaxed from the last key to min_pool), draws with replacement in (session, ticker-index) order from one numpy default_rng(seed)

paired_statistic.definition: per flag (or trade), its outcome minus the mean outcome of its matched controls; the statistic is the mean excess with a session-cluster bootstrap over signal sessions (backtest.paired_excess: trades signalled on one session are resampled together)
paired_statistic.p: one-sided for mean excess > 0: (1 + resampled means <= 0) / (1 + resamples); floor about 1e-4
paired_statistic.refuse_when: n_clusters < 2: the gate is NOT judged (reported as not judged, never as passed)
paired_statistic.harness_p: the harness's draw-distribution p (rule mean placed in the distribution of control portfolio means) is reported, not judged: anti-conservative when the rule's trades are more volatile than the controls'

selection.note: e3.admissibility reads this block verbatim (Stage 2 and Stage 4 harness rows)

0_reproduce.what: per market, every precondition run re-run from ITS recorded summary.json config (RunConfig fields) on the pinned panel (and registry on IDX), with the recorded lookahead setting; the rule-side statistics (signals, scored, status_counts, avg_net_return) must be identical

accepted_deviation.cause: controls.py commit bcb89f0 (a listed day without trades counts as zero traded value in the liquidity bucket) changed the matched draws after the IDX run was recorded: the matched baseline differs in the fourth decimal (research/E3/reproduce/result.json shows -0.004404 recorded vs -0.004400 reproduced); the only accepted deviation

0_reproduce.status: REPRODUCED when the rule side is identical and the matched baseline is identical or within the accepted tolerance (then matched_baseline = DEVIATES_WITHIN_ACCEPTED_TOLERANCE on record); otherwise DEVIATES, and discovery runs only with --accept-deviation, both sides on record
0_reproduce.descriptive: in-flag break-even precision p* of the reproduced run's trades (stages.2_execution.oracle_bound), reported

1_information.what: discovery, fill-independent: fit the two labels, fix the two thresholds, compute the debounced flags, and for every arm the plan-window return on the reference chain for flags and matched controls alike (entry level at the plan's entry session: close of t+1 on IDX, open of t+1 on US and CRYPTO = level(t+1) x open(t+1)/close(t+1); exit level at the close of the 5th session after entry, t+6; NaN when either level is missing; no fill, lot, lock or cost filter), AUC_U and AUC_D of the arm score over the evaluable discovery ticker-days, E30 and D30 precision with Wilson bounds, lift vs base and vs matched controls (with a session-cluster CI and the draw-distribution p), the directional ratio U/D with a cluster-bootstrap CI, the pre-move split (ret1 < 0.10 vs >= 0.10), the univariate matched-set table for every ranked and binary feature, the A0/A1 rows, the constant-column report, the IDX by-regime split
1_information.flags: debounced flags on evaluable (labelled) in-period ticker-days, as the harness would signal them (tradeable, column >= WARMUP); in-period flags without a label are counted separately

gate_to_stage_2.rule: flags >= min_flags AND paired gross (plan-window) excess mean > 0 with cluster-bootstrap one-sided p < alpha AND mean excess > 0 in every discovery calendar year with >= min_flags_per_year flags; not judged when n_clusters < 2

1_information.alpha_note: 0.025 = Bonferroni over the two primaries; the same gate is computed for every arm, the others being diagnostic
diagnostics: variance-detection check: Arm A's D30 lift vs matched inside the cluster CI of its E30 lift vs matched

univariate.events: U-episode starts (e1.Study.start at 1.30) on the evaluable discovery ticker-days
univariate.auc: P(event value > control value) + 0.5 P(tie) within matched sets (E1 signal_stats)
univariate.lift: the feature's own debounced top-0.5% flag (rank at or above its discovery 99.5th percentile; binaries: the state itself), E30 precision, lift vs base and vs matched controls with the detection sampler

1_information.plan_window_eligibility: a flag's plan window (entry close t+1, exit close t+1+H) counts in the paired plan-window statistic only when its exit session t+1+H is inside the period, for the flag and for its matched controls alike; label eligibility is unchanged (t and t+H inside the period); the discovery study holds the period's sessions only, never a later row; both denominators are recorded in stage1.json eligibility (finding A: v1 scored flags of the last eligible session, IDX 2022-12-23, US 2022-12-22, CRYPTO 2022-12-26, with the first post-period close)

2_execution.what: discovery; only arms that passed the Stage-1 gate (plus A1 if its gate passed): backtest.run under the market plan with the market's primary fill model and controls v3, then backtest.paired_excess on the trades; every harness run (primary, each sensitivity, the v2 report run) is one row of plans.csv with the paired-excess dict flattened
admissible_iff: e3.admissibility verbatim on the primary run (selection block: scored >= 200, average net > 0, harness p vs matched < 0.05, average net > 0 in every discovery year with >= 50 scored)
paired NET excess over matched controls > 0 with cluster-bootstrap one-sided p < alpha_paired_net (not judged when n_clusters < 2)
every judged sensitivity keeps rule average net minus matched-random average net > 0

admissibility holds on the subset of the primary run's scored trades whose exit-session participation (exit shares x share factor over the exit session's panel volume) is <= exit_participation_max: scored >= min_scored, average net > 0, paired net p < alpha_paired_net, average net > 0 in every discovery year with >= min_scored_per_year scored (the harness draw p is not re-computable on a subset; the paired p stands in for it, declared)
2_execution.literals: the arms have no frozen literals yet at this stage: the harness runs inject discovery/model.json into the module's literal tables in-process for the duration of the run (e5.literals_from), so the rule hash recorded in plans.csv is the pre-freeze module's and the coefficients used are those of model.json, whose sha256 is recorded in every row (literals_sha256); Stage 3 makes them literal and Stage 4 runs carry the frozen hash
2_execution.selected_per_market: when both arms are admissible, the market's primary arm is SELECTED (IDX A, CRYPTO B); otherwise (and on US) the admissible arm with the larger paired net mean excess, ties to A; SELECTED is what MOONSHOT_E5_<MARKET>_D1 computes; every other admissible arm is validated under its candidate rule id
2_execution.oracle_bound: in-flag break-even precision p* = (matched - E[net | flag, not E30]) / (E[net | flag, E30] - E[net | flag, not E30]) on the run's scored trades (E30 = the U label of the signal session); descriptive, never a criterion

3_freeze.what: e5-freeze --market copies discovery/model.json (coefficients, intercepts, thresholds) into the moonshot_e5.py literal tables for that market and adds (market, arm) to SELECTED for the selected arm (gates.json); refuses when any of the market's literals is already set or the market is already in SELECTED; writes <MARKET>/freeze/result.json; the orchestrator commits the module and the stage directory together
3_freeze.a0_a1_note: freezing changes every E5 rule's hash, A0/A1's included; write_run-recorded A0/A1 runs (validation) happen only after the freeze commit, so their rule sha is the frozen one; Stage-2 discovery runs are plans.csv rows, not recorded runs

4_validation.what: the validation period only, after the freeze commit: e5-validation refuses unless the module's literals equal discovery/model.json exactly and SELECTED names the selected arm; one write_run-recorded harness run per Stage-2-admissible arm (MOONSHOT_E5_<MARKET>_D1 for the selected arm, E5_CAND_<MARKET>_<ARM> for any other) plus one recorded run per judged sensitivity; the detection check on the validation study
pass_iff: paired net excess > 0 with cluster-bootstrap one-sided p < alpha_paired_net
every judged sensitivity keeps rule average net minus matched average net > 0 (same sign)
detection: E30 precision Wilson lower bound of the arm's validation flags > the validation E30 base rate
4_validation.claim_level: PROVISIONAL (2023 is once-seen): licenses a prospective paper policy only
reported_not_judged: 2023 is one year: no per-year check is possible

admissibility.stage_2: stages.2_execution.admissible_iff (e3.admissibility on the selection block, plus the paired, sensitivity and exit-capacity clauses)

validation.on: validation only, per market, recorded harness runs

consequences.stage_1_fails_in_both_primaries: daily-bar T-0 direction is not detectable by this learner over this feature list in the two markets where it can be measured; stop building tape-only detectors; the next protocol is information timing (EDGAR 8-K acceptance) after the SEC reachability probe; the KOD tape feed is not stood up unless the A1 row's lift CI excludes 1
consequences.stage_1_passes_stage_2_or_validation_fai: information exists but is not executable under daily-bar plans with these costs and fills; next work is an execution contract (limit-on-open, capacity, exit liquidity), not plan search; the prospective sidecar keeps scoring the frozen ranker
consequences.validation_passes: MOONSHOT_E5_<MARKET>_D1 stays frozen; a new POLICY_ID (PAPER-POLICY-v5) may wire it through paper._detector; NO paper BUY until >= 100 prospective scored E5 decisions show paired excess > 0 (pre-registered); the holdout stays sealed until then
consequences.A1_row_lift_ci_excludes_1: stand up a scan-only KOD feed under a new scanner id; otherwise VOLUME_CREEP_PRICE_QUIET is closed at KOD-DET-v0 thresholds

declared_leaks.2023_once_seen: 2023 is once-seen for the univariate siblings of E5's features: ara via E1, ret1 via E2, brk60 via US_BREAKOUT_v1; the complete 2023 positive class with ret5, ret20, volr, rngr, vol20, dd60, zero20, up5 at the decision close sits on disk in research/E1/validation/episodes_E30.csv, research/E2/US/validation/episodes_E30.csv and research/E2/CRYPTO/validation/episodes_E30.csv (and the E50/E100 siblings beside them)
declared_leaks.consequence: any 2023 pass is PROVISIONAL and licenses only a prospective paper policy, never the holdout
declared_leaks.crypto_panel: the legacy v1 crypto panel carries two future-informed row deletions (LUNA 2022-05-13 in discovery among them): declared, not rebuilt, because a rebuild would make Stage 0 DEVIATE

not_fixed_and_why: 2023 once-seen: no clean year exists in-repo; mitigated by pre-registration, Bonferroni over the two primaries, the provisional claim level and the prospective sidecar
US survivorship: no point-in-time universe on free data; US demoted to diagnostic

bounded learner: a null is 'not found by this learner over this feature list'; the management consequence (stop tape-only detector building) is a decision, not a theorem; a second learner is a new protocol
IDX closing-auction spread: a one-tick-per-side sensitivity only; a panel-v3 with mirror bid/offer depth is deferred
crypto legacy panel: two future-informed row deletions (LUNA 2022-05-13 included) declared, not rebuilt, because a causal rebuild would make the precondition DEVIATE
daily bars only: no intraday path; the crypto open is a zero-latency print, hence the close(t+1) sensitivity
serial dependence of rank-based flags: addressed by the debounce and the session-cluster bootstrap, not by a name-level cluster (distinct names are reported)
search_size: 6 fits, 2 arms x 3 markets, 2 primaries, no threshold/lambda/feature search; stated in every output

notes.trades_columns: trades.csv.gz of every E5-era run carries 14 columns (the 12 recorded ones plus matched_mean_net_return and same_session_mean_net_return); recorded files are unchanged
notes.stage_outputs: research/E5/<MARKET>/<stage>/ (reproduce, discovery, freeze, validation), each a new directory (exist_ok=False), every file deterministic given the protocol, the panel and the seeds apart from computed_at; discovery writes model.json, thresholds.json, stage1.json, univariate.csv, flags.csv, plans.csv, gates.json, summary.json and one harness summary per Stage-2 run under runs/<RunConfig market>/<arm>_<run>.json, so the CRYPTO_CLOSE sensitivity is keyed by its own name (runs/CRYPTO_CLOSE/) inside the CRYPTO stage directory
notes.summary_config: every harness summary.json config block of the E5 era carries tick_cost (false unless the IDX one_tick_cost sensitivity is on) beside the recorded fields; recorded files are unchanged, and Stage 0 compares statistics, never bytes
notes.stage_4_targets: e5.validation_targets: every Stage-2-admissible arm (the selected one as MOONSHOT_E5_<MARKET>_D1, any other as E5_CAND_<MARKET>_<ARM>) and A1 when its Stage-2 row was admissible (E5_CAND_A1_CREEP_QUIET_NR, recorded only after the freeze commit)
notes.study_options: e1.Study is built with pool_version v3, the market's pool_units and its declared panel_format (passed as the keyword too); summary.json carries study_options

claims: Historical research on assumed costs, daily-bar fills and a survivor-only US universe; 6 fits and 2 primaries were pre-registered and nothing else was searched; nothing here is prospective performance, no probability or trade is asserted, nothing grants entry permission, and no real orders exist.

addendum.kind: audit correction after seeing the v1 results; not independent validation

A_discovery_boundary.witness: IDX Arm A flag INPS on 2022-12-23: label window ends 2022-12-30 (eligible), plan exit 2023-01-02 (validation); its plan_return and its controls' changed when only the 2023-01-02 close changed

B_age_instability.witness: moonshot_e5 derived age from the first observation inside the window; moving the window past a listing changed same-date age ranks and fitted scores beyond the warm-up; the v1 invariance fixture had every name listed before the window
B_age_instability.required_history: the pinned panel's own rows before the window start (available); no listing metadata is used or invented

addendum.unchanged: thresholds, alpha, learner, feature list, plans, periods, seeds, draws, gates, markets, panels: identical to v1
disclosed_not_fixed: controls v2/v3 listing_age buckets a name present at the window's first session as 'older' (controls.py) and counts the others from their first in-window session: window-dependent in the same way; left unchanged because the matched baselines of the recorded E1/E2/E3 runs depend on it (Stage 0 must still reproduce them); affects the detection pool only through pool_version v3's keys (price_band, liquidity, volatility, market_cap: not listing_age)

overlapping plan windows of flags on adjacent sessions share market moves and sit in different session clusters; the session-cluster bootstrap does not fully resolve that dependence, so p-values and intervals remain somewhat anti-conservative
